persons.name: Jayabhūpatīndramalla
persons.evidence: śrīśrījaya bhūpatīndramarlladevasana, panātiyā khoho kvāṭhagṛhe patisthāyatā dayakasya bijyāka thva puṣṭakaḥ

notes: King Jayabhūpatīndramalla of Bhaktapur commissioned the manuscript for the consecration (pratiṣṭhā) of the Khoho fort/palace (kvāṭhagṛha) at Panauti (Panāti).
